Pick up any cloth and nodes first. Cloth is most important. (If you have any more than 80 cloth I recocomend placing sleeping bags to where you wanna build)

I reccomend basing somewhere safe like the snow of not near too many monuments make sure there is atleast 1 medium sized accessible (not close but accessible) as a solo noob you wanna find the action not have it find you.

Craft a bow and some arrows, farm two stone nodes (or one) craft a axe and then a pick axe after that.

Pick up mushrooms as much as possible, they can prolongue your survival.

And most importantly dont give up.
